name: gosavetool
title: GoSaveTool Text and Image Tools
description: Count words and characters, check social media limits, change text case, make URL slugs, and convert or compress images to WebP, JPG and PNG. Works offline, nothing is uploaded.
author: codivalabtech

commands.name: count-words
commands.title: Count Words and Characters
commands.description: Words, characters, sentences, reading time and social media limits of the selected text or the clipboard.

commands.name: check-social-limits
commands.title: Check Social Media Limits
commands.description: See if the text fits an X post, Instagram caption, TikTok caption, YouTube title, SEO title or meta description.

commands.name: change-case
commands.title: Change Case
commands.description: Turn the selected text or the clipboard into UPPER, lower, Title, Sentence, camelCase, PascalCase, snake_case, kebab-case or a URL slug.

commands.name: make-slug
commands.title: Make URL Slug
commands.description: Copy a clean URL slug of the selected text or the clipboard.

commands.name: compress-image
commands.title: Compress Image
commands.description: Make PNG, JPG and WebP files smaller and optionally resize them, on your computer.

commands.name: convert-image
commands.title: Convert Image Format
commands.description: Convert images between PNG, JPG and WebP, on your computer.

commands.name: search-online-tools
commands.title: Search Online Tools
commands.description: Open the free GoSaveTool online tools for subtitles, images and text.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the `prepublishOnly` script and rerun `npm publish` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use `npm run publish` instead.

" && exit 1
